governed_chains.name: Founder-to-Student Publication Chain
governed_chains.flow: Founder Web -> Backend -> governed state -> Student-safe projection -> Student App
governed_chains.security_constraint: Only verified canonical publications can drive student projections. Fallbacks must be review-required.

governed_chains.name: Student Evidence Feedback Loop
governed_chains.flow: Student App -> evidence -> Student state -> treatment -> PERS route -> Student App
governed_chains.security_constraint: Student actions generate evidence events processed on-server to compute treatment and routing decisions.

governed_chains.name: AAF Integration Chain
governed_chains.security_constraint: AAF version recovery and supersession triggers immediately invalidate stale client projections.
